rules.statement: Under the Jaffna Matrimonial Rights and Inheritance Ordinance, No. 1 of 1911, minor heirs of a deceased wife are not bound by a mortgage decree if they were not made parties to the action.
rules.supporting_quote: "The minor defendants therefore not having been made parties are not bound by the mortgage decree."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Jaffna Matrimonial Rights and Inheritance Ordinance, No. 1 of 1911, Section 22
